title: Financial Reporting Analyst - Alternatives
desc: At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership—it’s our approach to business and relationships. We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what’s next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career. Job Description Financial Reporting Analyst - Alternatives: Key Responsibilities: Financial Reporting Draft annual and quarterly financial statements for private equity and hedge funds, as well as internal calendars for such deliverables. Work with the Fund Reporting Manager on the preparation of procedures. Develop and maintain a working familiarity with applicable laws, regulations and interpretations governing financial statements and disclosure, including the Investment Company Act of 1940, the Internal Revenue Code, US GAAP and IFRS, and other applicable requirements. Maintain awareness of regulatory changes affecting funds. Communicate appropriately with the Financial Reporting Team Leader with respect to all timetables and workflow. Communicate appropriately with other departments within BBH about all relevant matters. Technology/Innovation/Productivity Evaluate and suggest enhancements to BBH Accounting system (STAR) and BBH Financial Reporting system (Unity) to automate procedures for financial reporting and compliance purposes. Teamwork Perform special projects as directed by the Financial Reporting Team Leader. Assist in the review of work completed by junior level staff members in relation to internal policies, procedures and systems as required. Education level and/or relevant experience(s) BS/BA degree in Business related concentration preferred, or equivalent discipline, and/or equivalent work experience. 3 to 5 years of alternative and/or mutual fund industry experience including 1 to 2 years of prior financial reporting and/or alternative investment experience. Highly organized, detail oriented, self-motivated. Proven ability to problem solve and recommend solutions. Strong aptitude for accuracy and attention to detail. Capable of monitoring and completing a variety of projects simultaneously. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills. Strong excel skills. Willingness and ability to work in a client-driven, deadline-oriented environment. What We Offer: A collaborative environment that enables you to step outside your role to add value wherever you can Direct access to clients, information and experts across all business areas around the world Opportunities to grow your expertise, take on new challenges, and reinvent yourself—without leaving the firm A culture of inclusion that values each employee’s unique perspective High-quality benefits program emphasizing good health, financial security, and peace of mind Rewarding work with the flexibility to enjoy personal and family experiences at every career stage Salary Range $70,000 - $100,000 + annual target bonus BBH and its affiliates' compensation program includes base salary, discretionary bonuses, and profit-sharing. The anticipated base salary range(s) shown above are only for the indicated location(s) and may differ in other locations due to cost of living and labor considerations. Base salaries may vary based on factors such as skill, experience and qualification for the role. BBH's total rewards package recognizes your contributions with more than just a paycheck—providing you with benefits that enhance your experience at BBH from long-term savings, healthcare, and income protection to professional development opportunities and time off, our programs support your overall well-being. We value diverse experiences. We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn’t followed a traditional path, includes alternative experiences, or doesn’t meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply. About BBH: Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us. We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. We are relentless problem solvers who know our best ideas come from collective debate and development—so we are never possessive about our ideas. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice—creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another. We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often—pushing the boundaries of innovation. As a private partnership, every investment we make is in the relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours. Go to BBH.com to learn more about our rewards and benefits , philanthropy , approach to sustainability or how we support you to thrive personally, physically and financially .

title: Data Engineer
location: Austin, TX, US ; Southlake, TX, US
desc: Your Opportunity At Schwab, you’re empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us challenge the status quo and transform the finance industry together. We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location(s). As a Data Engineer on the Schwab Technology Services Insights team, you will build and support enterprise data warehouse solutions that enable reliable analytics and reporting. You will use Informatica, advanced SQL, and dimensional data modeling to develop scalable data pipelines, improve data quality, and deliver accurate information to business partners. Your work will include designing and optimizing ETL and ELT processes, validating production results, resolving complex data issues, and strengthening monitoring, audit, lineage, and recovery controls. You will collaborate with business analysts, architects, quality assurance teams, product owners, and production support partners to translate requirements into effective technical solutions. Success in this role requires analytical thinking, sound decision-making, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement. What you have Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience in data engineering, data integration, ETL development, or data warehousing. 3+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise data pipelines using Informatica. Experience developing mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, reusable components, parameterized processes, scheduling, monitoring, and error-handling solutions. Advanced SQL skills with experience developing complex transformations, reconciling data, tuning performance, and validating production results. Experience with dimensional data modeling, fact and dimension design, slowly changing dimensions, and ETL or ELT patterns. Demonstrated analytical thinking and problem-solving skills used to diagnose data issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable solutions. Experience translating business requirements into technical designs, transformation rules, source-to-target specifications, and test scenarios. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud, including Cloud Data Integration. Experience with Informatica PowerCenter or migrating legacy Informatica workloads to cloud-based platforms. Experience implementing data-quality, validation, exception-handling, restartability, audit, lineage, and operational monitoring controls. Experience with Google Cloud data services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Cloud Composer, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, or Dataproc. Python or Java experience supporting data engineering, automation, or integration solutions. Experience with Agile delivery, source control, continuous integration and deployment, testing, release readiness, and production support. Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, Bamboo, Liquibase, Terraform, or comparable development and deployment tools. Experience partnering across technical and business teams to deliver scalable data solutions. Informatica or Google Cloud certification. In addition to the salary range, this role is eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities.

title: Data Engineer (Natural Gas)
desc:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


About the Role
As a Data Engineer on our Natural Gas team, you will be dedicated to building and scaling a brand-new intelligence product covering the US natural gas markets. Operating within our backend engineering squad, you will expand our data acquisition capabilities, optimize high-throughput data distribution, and support the development of tailored analytics. Your work will directly equip global energy traders and market analysts with reliable, real-time insights into North American gas flows.

 Scale and structure data acquisition: Codify, structure, expand, and maintain robust data scrapers and ingestion pipelines to capture US natural gas market datasets. Enrich product capabilities: Collaborate across the team to design and ship new data features and tailored analytics for our expanding natural gas offering. Optimize API performance and distribution: Ensure high availability, speed, and reliability across our RESTful APIs to distribute datasets seamlessly to end users. Build observability and alerting tools: Develop and enhance monitoring dashboards and proactive alerting systems to safeguard data integrity and pipeline health. Shape sustainable product roadmaps: Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Analysts, and DevOps teams to build ambitious yet sustainable technical plans . What you'll need (Must-haves) Data engineering foundation: Circa 3–5 years of experience as a data-focused Software Engineer building and maintaining production data pipelines. Strong Python & API expertise: Significant experience working with Python (FastAPI is a plus) alongside proficiency in building and consuming RESTful APIs. Database design & time-series data: Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or similar data stores, encompassing database design, data normalization, and handling time-series or event data. Performance optimization: Solid understanding of API performance optimization and caching strategies. Modern engineering workflows & communication: Comfortable working with Git, peer code reviews, and Agile methodologies, backed by a strong command of written and spoken English and a BSc/MSc in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience . Nice-to-haves Cloud & orchestration tooling: Experience with AWS (or another cloud provider) using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and production orchestration tools like Apache Airflow. Containerization & architecture: Practical experience with Docker and Kubernetes, as well as familiarity with hexagonal and medallion architecture patterns. Observability & NoSQL databases: Experience utilizing monitoring solutions (e.g., Datadog, Grafana) and working with NoSQL data stores . We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?
 
We make things happen
We act decisively and with purpose, going the extra mile.
 
We build together
We foster relationships and develop creative solutions to address market challenges.
 
We are here to help
We are accessible and supportive to colleagues and clients with a friendly approach.
 
 
Our People Pledge
 
Don’t meet every single requirement? Research shows that women and people of color are less likely than others to apply if they feel like they don’t match 100% of the job requirements. Don’t let the confidence gap stand in your way, we’d love to hear from you! We understand that experience comes in many different forms and are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
 
Kpler is committed to providing a fair, inclusive and diverse work-environment. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global community. title: Strategy & Business Intelligence Analyst
location: Atlanta, GA ; Atlanta, GA (United States of America)
desc: At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One. Job Description The Strategy & Business Intelligence Analyst is responsible for partnering with business and product stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into actionable analytics and reporting solutions. This position acts as the bridge between Stakeholders/business users and analytics teams - leads requirements‑gathering efforts to identify KPIs, converts business requirements into clear, validated user stories, and supports the development of high‑quality dashboards and self‑service analytics tools. The role ensures analytical outputs are accurate, well‑documented, and fit for decision‑making by promoting transparency, consistency, and data integrity across insights delivery. Responsibilities Lead business insights requirements-gathering sessions to identify KPI needs for use cases Translate business needs into well-defined requirements. Validate requirements with stakeholders to ensure alignment, clarity, and feasibility. Create clear, concise user stories for dashboards and reports. Support the development and enhancement of analytics tools, dashboards, and self-service reporting. Ensure output accuracy and integrity through detailed validation. Document methodologies, assumptions, and definitions to promote transparency and repeatability Partner with business and product stakeholders to understand objectives, pain points, and key decision needs Lead requirements-gathering sessions to define business questions, analytical use cases Translate business needs into well-defined requirements. Validate requirements with stakeholders to ensure alignment, clarity, and feasibility Create clear, concise user stories for dashboards, reports Ensure output accuracy, integrity through detailed validation Support the development and enhancement of analytics tools, dashboards, and self-service reporting Basic Qualifications Typically five or more years of related experience. Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience. Experience in financial services, banking, treasury management, payments, or fintech Preferred Skills/Experience Three or more years of experience in business analysis, analytics, or a related field. Experience in financial services, banking, treasury management, payments, or fintech. Experience supporting business intake processes including documenting incoming requests, defining scope, capturing requirements and maintaining intake documentation. Ability to translate intake requirements into clear Jira user-stories, epics and acceptance criteria. Working knowledge of Jira and Agile/Scrum methodologies including backlog management. Strong analytical skills to assess data, identify trends and generate actionable insights. Experience creating reports, dashboards or analyses using tools such as Excel and Power BI/Tableau. Ability to develop and deliver training materials, conduct knowledge‑transfer sessions and support end‑user adoption. Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively collaborate with business and technical stakeholders. Detail‑oriented, highly organized, and strong ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment. Ability to independently structure ambiguous problems and deliver clear insights. Strong attention-to-detail with a bias toward accuracy and data integrity. Executive presence and the ability to influence without authority. Proactive mindset, i.e., anticipates business questions before they are asked. Key Success Factors Ability to independently structure ambiguous problems and deliver clear insights Strong attention to detail with a bias toward accuracy and data integrity Executive presence and the ability to influence without authority Proactive mindset—anticipates business questions before they are asked Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, matrixed environment If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants . Benefits: Our approach to benefits and total rewards considers our team members’ whole selves and what may be needed to thrive in and outside work. That's why our benefits are designed to help you and your family boost your health, protect your financial security and give you peace of mind. Our benefits include the following: Healthcare (medical, dental, vision) Basic term and optional term life insurance Short-term and long-term disability Pregnancy disability and parental leave 401(k) and employer-funded retirement plan Paid vacation (from two to five weeks depending on salary grade and tenure) Up to 11 paid holiday opportunities Adoption assistance Sick and Safe Leave accruals of one hour for every 30 worked, up to 80 hours per calendar year unless otherwise provided by law Review our full benefits available by employment status here . title: Business Intelligence Engineer, SWA BI
desc: Are you excited about turning raw data into meaningful insights that drive real business decisions? Do you enjoy building dashboards, writing queries, and partnering with teams to answer critical questions? As a Business Intelligence Engineer at Amazon, you will design and deliver data solutions that help leaders make informed, timely decisions. You will work across data pipelines, visualization tools, and analytical frameworks to create reporting solutions that directly influence how Amazon operates and serves its customers. This is an opportunity to grow your technical and analytical skills while making a tangible impact at one of the world's most customer-focused companies. Key job responsibilities - Build small to mid-size business intelligence solutions — including data sets, queries, reports, dashboards, and analyses — to answer business questions with data, delivering end products on schedule using well-defined requirements. - Write secure, stable, testable, and maintainable SQL and ETL code, automating manual processes where possible and creating data structures using schema definition languages. - Use industry analytics visualization tools such as Tableau, QuickSight, or PowerBI, along with statistical methods as needed, to deliver actionable insights to stakeholders and enable data-driven decisions. - Collaborate with business teams, data scientists, and internal partners to refine requirements, validate outputs against source data and business logic, and ensure deliverables align with expectations. - Troubleshoot data issues and analyses, research root causes, propose solutions, and take responsibility for resolution while clearly documenting solutions for ease of use and maintainability. A day in the life You might start your morning reviewing a dashboard you recently built, checking that overnight data refreshes completed correctly and metrics look consistent. From there, you could join a working session with a product or business team to scope out a new reporting request, translating their questions into a technical approach. In the afternoon, you might write and test SQL queries, refine a visualization for an upcoming leadership review, or pair with a teammate to debug an ETL pipeline. Each interaction deepens your understanding of the business and sharpens your technical craft. About the team Our team is focused on making data accessible and actionable across the organization. We build the reporting and analytical tools that help our partners understand performance, identify opportunities, and make confident decisions. We value collaboration, clear communication, and a genuine curiosity about the problems we solve. As we continue to expand the scope and sophistication of our intelligence solutions, you will have the chance to grow alongside the team and contribute to projects that shape how Amazon uses data every day. - 2+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience - Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools - Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared) - Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R) - Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Management/Systems, Business Analytics or other related discipline - Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree - Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design - Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis Amazon

title: Copy of Copy of Data Analyst
desc: Dover Tactical – Slate Ridge Division is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst to support its business operations through data organization, reporting, and performance analysis. This position involves collecting, reviewing, and interpreting business information to help identify trends, maintain accurate records, and support informed operational decisions. The ideal candidate should enjoy working with spreadsheets, organizing information, identifying patterns, and turning raw data into useful reports. This role is suitable for someone with strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and an interest in business operations. Key Responsibilities Collect, organize, and analyze business and operational data. Review records to identify inconsistencies, errors, and missing information. Prepare regular reports, spreadsheets, and performance summaries. Monitor business activity and identify trends or patterns. Maintain accurate digital records and organized data files. Use spreadsheet tools to summarize and present findings. Assist with tracking inventory, sales-related information, and operational performance where applicable. Support management with data reports and administrative insights. Collaborate with relevant departments to verify information. Maintain confidentiality when handling business and customer information. Qualifications Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Good numerical skills and attention to detail. Familiarity with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets. Ability to organize, interpret, and present information clearly. Good written communication and reporting skills. Basic understanding of data management and reporting. Knowledge of SQL, Power BI, or other analytical tools is an advantage. Previous experience in data analysis, reporting, or administrative support is preferred but not required. Compensation & Benefits Competitive hourly compensation. $350 Sign up Bonus Flexible scheduling options, depending on position availability. Paid training and onboarding. Paid time off for eligible employees. Paid holidays, where applicable. Employee assistance and wellness resources. Performance-based recognition opportunities. Professional development and skills training. Advancement opportunities as the company grows. Supportive team environment. Company-provided work resources, where applicable. Training & Onboarding New employees will receive training on company policies, email communication standards, customer service procedures, recordkeeping, privacy practices, and the internal systems used to manage customer inquiries. The training process is designed to help new team members understand their responsibilities and feel comfortable working independently.
